text:
Leah (AE): Nimbus Financial on call: they insist on 14-day deletion for request logs and want confirmation we can meet SCCs, plus a list of subprocessors. Also asked if Dedicated deployment is needed or hosted can suffice. Need a SIG/CAIQ-friendly reply and a DPA log clause.

Mira (Security): Quick take: hosted default retention is 180d. We can offer contract-configurable retention down to 14d for processed/searchable logs by enabling ingestion PII-stripping and aggressive TTLs on indices. Raw immutable backups and cold storage may be longer unless Dedicated/Private. Subprocessor list: standard cloud infra + monitoring vendor; I'll pull current inventory.

Julian (Privacy): DSAR perspective: deletion vs irreversibly pseudonymize — Nimbus wants full deletions. For hosted, we can commit to deleting from search indices and application logs within 14d SLA, and to pseudonymize any remaining raw artifacts unless they take Dedicated. Must be explicit in DPA about exceptions (backups, forensics) and recovery windows.

Leah (AE): They also care about SCCs (standard contractual clauses) and need confirmation we have EU transfers covered.

Mira (Security): We have SCCs in place; for CAIQ/SIG answers: mark "Transfers" as SCCs signed via our DPA template, and subprocessors listed with links. For the SIG question on "Data deletion": propose this sentence: "For hosted customers, Redwood will delete or irreversibly pseudonymize customer-identifying data from processed logs and indices within the contractual SLA; backups may be retained per backup retention schedule unless otherwise agreed."

DevOps Bot: INF-1289 created: "ingestion-pii-strip" (owner: eng-logging). ETA: 2w. INF-1290: "dsar-deletion-sweep" (owner: infra-search). ETA: 3w.

Julian (Privacy): Draft DPA snippet to hand to Legal (rough): "Redwood will, upon customer request, delete or irreversibly pseudonymize customer-identifiable data from application and request logs retained in searchable indices within 14 calendar days. Redwood will provide a deletion certificate and description of systems searched. Exceptions: forensic holds, legal obligations, or retention required by law; in such events Redwood will notify Customer and limit access."

Legal: Noted. We'll change "14 calendar days" to "14 business days" if Nimbus insists, but prefer calendar for clarity. Also will add subprocessor notification clause.

Leah (AE): Pricing question from Nimbus: what is the surcharge for 14d hosted retention + DSAR certs vs baseline? They also asked cost/benefit of Dedicated to satisfy tight deletion/backup SLAs.

Mira (Security): Operational note for SIG: we should avoid promising instantaneous wipe from immutable cold backups for hosted. Recommend presenting two options: (A) Hosted w/ 14d processed-index deletion + ingestion masking + deletion cert (additional monthly fee + per-request DSAR charge). (B) Dedicated/Private deployment with customer-managed storage and contractual full raw log purge on request (higher price, longer procurement).

Julian (Privacy): Also requested: workflow for DSARs in the RFP. I'll add a short runbook: intake -> identity verification -> search indices -> deletion job -> cert -> update customer. SLA 14d for hosted processed indices, 30d for full audit across systems (unless Dedicated).

Leah (AE): Action items: Mira: publish subprocessor list and confirm INF ticket ETAs. Julian: finalize DPA wording and the DSAR workflow. Legal: prepare SIG/CAIQ language and update DPA to include subprocessor appendix. I'll send Nimbus the two-option proposal and pricing delta.

Mira (Security): Subprocessor list (link): cloud-provider, metrics-vendor, alerting-provider. I'll DM full CSV. INF-1289/1290 OK. No infra blockers but will need PO for expedited work.

DevOps Bot: INF-1289 status: in triage. INF-1290 status: planned.

Legal: Drafted DPA appendix for logs and subprocessor table. Julian, please review and comment.

Julian (Privacy): Reviewing now. One edit: include "deletion certificate will include hash of deleted record identifiers and timestamp" to prove action without sharing PII.

Leah (AE): Perfect. I'll schedule a follow-up demo with Nimbus and include the draft DPA snippet and the two-option pricing. :calendar:
